title: Impact of Compulsory Schooling on Wages

llm_response.content:
## 1. Identification Strategy
The suitable causal method here is Instrumental Variables (IV) estimation. The "compulsory schooling year" variable \( z \) serves as the instrument for education \( x \). The key assumption is that the instrument affects wages only through its impact on education and is independent of other factors influencing wages. This addresses potential endogeneity issues where educational attainment could be correlated with unobserved factors affecting wages.

## 2. R Code
```r
# Load necessary libraries
library(AER)

# Read the data from the provided CSV file
data <- read.csv("experiments/exp_b/data/s68_data.csv")

# Define the instrument (z), endogenous regressor (x), and outcome (y)
instrument <- "z"
endogenous <- "x"
outcome <- "y"

# Run the first stage regression (optional, for diagnostic purposes)
first_stage <- lm(as.formula(paste(endogenous, "~", instrument, "+ controls")), data = data)
summary(first_stage)

# Run the 2SLS regression using IV estimation
iv_model <- ivreg(as.formula(paste(outcome, "~", endogenous, "+ controls |", instrument, "+ controls")), data = data)

# Print the results
summary(iv_model)

# Robustness check: Check if the instrument is weak
# Using the F-statistic from the first stage regression
first_stage_fstat <- summary(first_stage)$fstatistic
names(first_stage_fstat) <- NULL
cat("First stage F-statistic:", first_stage_fstat[1], "\n")

# Interpretation of results
cat("IV Coefficient for education on log wages:", coef(iv_model)[endogenous], "\n")
```

## 3. Expected Findings
I expect the sign of the IV coefficient on education to be positive since education typically yields a return in terms of higher wages. The magnitude can vary, but studies generally find returns to an additional year of schooling to be in the range of 5-10% in terms of increased wages. Given the use of instrumental variables, we might find a coefficient at the upper end of this range if the instrument effectively captures exogenous variation in education.

_ground_truth.identification_strategy: Use compulsory schooling year as an instrument for education.
_ground_truth.conclusion_detail: The analysis suggests that additional compulsory schooling has a negative impact on log wages.
